meta.name: google-agents-cli-eval
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "run an evaluation", "evaluate my agent", "evaluate my ADK agent", "write an eval dataset", "analyze eval failures", "compare eval results", "optimize agent", or needs guidance on the Agent Platform eval methodology and the Quality Flywheel. Covers eval metrics, dataset schema, LLM-as-judge scoring, and common failure causes. Applies to any agents-cli project, whatever framework the agent is written in. Do NOT use for agent API code patterns (ADK: use google-agents-cli-adk-code), deployment (use google-agents-cli-deploy), or project scaffolding (use google-agents-cli-scaffold).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给自建 AI 代理跑评估,找出失败原因并持续提升质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发 AI 代理,想系统评估其表现并持续改进
copy.tagline_en: Run agent evaluations to find failure causes and steadily improve quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents and want to evaluate them systematically.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你评估 agent:编写或改动评估数据集、运行 eval 并给结果打分、按指标定位失败原因,还能对比前后两次结果。
howto.when: 当你提出「运行评估」「评估我的 ADK agent」「写评估数据集」等需求,或想要评估方法指导时触发;适用于任何 agents-cli 项目。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 eval run,看看现在 agent 的得分
say.note: 在数据集上运行 agent 并打分,输出结果文件

say.text: 对比上次和这次的评估结果,看目标指标有没有提升
say.note: 输出两次 results 的差异,确认是否回退

say.text: 分析这批失败的评估用例,归类失败原因
say.note: 用 eval analyze 聚类失败模式

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude evaluates your agent: it writes or edits eval datasets, runs the eval and grades traces, finds failing metrics, and compares two result files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to run an evaluation, evaluate your ADK agent, write an eval dataset, analyze failures, or compare results; works in any agents-cli project.

say_en.text: Run eval run and show me the agent's current scores
say_en.note: Runs the agent on the dataset and grades traces

say_en.text: Compare the previous and new eval results for the target metric
Analyze these failing eval cases and group the failure reasons
say_en.note: Clusters failure modes with eval analyze
